data.value: The value "{0}" in the "{1}" list has a frequency of {2}, but it must be from {3} to {4}.

data.name: CharacterSettingNotAllowed
data.value: The property "{0}" has a "{1}" setting, but its type can't use it.

data.name: CharacterOptionTextBlank
data.value: The value "{0}" of the property "{1}" has blank "{2}" text.
data.comment: {0} is the value's id. {1} is the property's id. {2} is the name of the text.

data.name: IntegerRangeInvalid
data.value: The "{0}" maximum is {1}, but it must be at least the minimum ({2}).
data.comment: {0} is the location of the range in the data file. {1} is the maximum found. {2} is the minimum found.

data.name: RoleValueUnknown
data.value: The "{0}" list includes "{1}", but the property has no value with that id.
data.comment: {0} is the name of the list in the data file. {1} is the value id.

data.name: StringDefaultsFormInvalid
data.value: The "{0}" setting must have either "values", or "keyedBy" and "valuesByKey".
data.comment: {0} is the location of the setting in the data file.

data.name: StringDefaultsKeyedByInvalid
data.value: The "{0}" setting is keyed by "{1}", but that isn't a value list property defined before this one.
data.comment: {0} is the location of the setting in the data file. {1} is the property id it is keyed by.

data.name: StringDefaultsKeyUnknown
data.value: The "{0}" setting has values for "{1}", but the property "{2}" has no value with that id.
data.comment: {0} is the location of the setting in the data file. {1} is the key. {2} is the id of the property it is keyed by.

data.name: StringDefaultsKeyMissing
data.value: The "{0}" setting has no values for "{1}", which is a value of the property "{2}".
data.comment: {0} is the location of the setting in the data file. {1} is the missing key. {2} is the id of the property it is keyed by.

data.name: TemplateRequired
data.value: The "templates" list needs a template with the id "{0}".
data.comment: {0} is the template's id.

data.name: TemplateMalformed
data.value: The "{0}" template has a brace that isn't part of a valid placeholder. Use "{{{{" and "}}}}" for literal braces.
data.comment: {0} is the template's id.

data.name: TemplatePropertyUnknown
data.value: The "{0}" template uses "{1}", but there is no character property or template with that id.
data.comment: {0} is the template's id. {1} is the id used in the template.

data.name: TemplateFieldNotAllowed

data.name: TemplateFieldMissing
data.value: The "{0}" template uses "{1}.{2}", but the value "{3}" has no "{2}" text.
data.comment: {0} is the template's id. {1} is the property id. {2} is the name of the text. {3} is the id of the value missing the text.

data.name: TemplateFormatUnknown
data.value: The "{0}" template uses the format "{1}", but the only supported format is "first_upper".
data.comment: {0} is the template's id. {1} is the format used in the template.

data.name: TemplateBlank
data.value: The template "{0}" is blank.
data.comment: {0} is the template's id.

data.name: TemplateIdIsProperty
data.value: The template "{0}" has the same id as a character property.
data.comment: {0} is the template's id.

data.name: TemplateCycle

data.comment: {0} is the template's id.
